module.note: Shared pipeline — also serves ModelPortfolios (Pod 4) and upload side for Pod 3. Contains 26+ Lambda functions. This DT has full deploy authority. Tag history advanced 2.3.4->2.4.11 via AE deploys (YALP_MDSRC B-series + positioning ETF-name sweeps) while this core doc lagged; reconciled 2026-06-26. yang-v2.4.12 = yang-model-portfolio-benchmarks additive index_benchmark_return + etf_benchmark_return in model_portfolio_timeseries (MDLP_RVVALT index/etf toggle; DS commit f3cfe6a4a, deploy 0.2.0_DT). yang-v2.4.16 = yang-generate-holdings-attribution parser hardening (commit 866583a87): format-detection now scans ALL columns for the 'vs Benchmark' header (was fixed [5,16,27]); fixes the June-2026 col-shifted export (headers 5/16/27->2/13/24) that yielded 0 models -> empty holdings_attribution_data.json/allocation_summary.json -> blank Attribution. Output shape unchanged; validated vs archived Jan-Jun files (Jun now 5 models, no regression). CodeSha256 m00Ju4xm9dbNC0NEXk5/MtLUCh0sSoA207DngNHGZ3A= live 2026-07-01T19:49:34Z (deploy 0.2.0_DT). yang-v2.4.17 = yang-model-portfolio-benchmarks monotonic publish guard + build-before-publish reorder (MDLP_MONPUB.W2; DS commit 05dcbe7651, source-map 573ee0bc11): older incoming data_as_of aborts ALL THREE benchmark writes (PublishGuardError, fail-closed on unreadable serve, force_publish=true loud bypass); build_rfr_daily/timeseries construction moved before first upload_json so a mid-build crash publishes nothing. CodeSha256 5EPfYG2SM2iFYDfPUKxQGQq/XNAkFkr1ROYpUKTXO1g= live 2026-08-03T15:46:38Z, 0-diff verified; IAM guard-read verified live via simulate-principal-policy on exact key ARN + separate positive/negative controls (deploy 0.2.0_DT). yang-v2.4.18 = W8 force_publish manifest-level read + rollback_execution_id in the bypass log (MDLP_MONPUB.W8; DS 4024664d71, one event-contract commit with data_refresh's fallback stamping). CodeSha256 Ml7okrOe6+2uT+hZScO6u3aSg8/lbacrD4Q1g8z74uY= live 2026-08-03T17:10:09Z, 0-diff (deploy 0.2.0_DT).
